# GamesIO

> Three classic mini-games right in your browser: breakout, snake and light cycles. No sign-up, no install, completely free. Works on phone and desktop.

GamesIO is a free, open-source collection of browser mini-games written in
plain JavaScript. No sign-up, no install, no tracking. Every game runs entirely
client side and stores high scores in localStorage. The site is available in
English (default) and Russian.

## Games

- [Breakout](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/breakout/): Clear every brick, catch power-ups and never drop the ball. Russian version: [Арканоид](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/arkanoid/).
- [Snake](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/snake/): Eat apples, grow longer and never bite yourself. Golden apples pay +50. Russian version: [Змейка](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/zmeyka/).
- [Snake Wars](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/snake-wars/): Tron-style light cycles: leave a wall behind you and outlast three bots. Russian version: [Змеиные войны](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/snake-wars/).
- [Sky Squadron](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/sky-squadron/): Vertical scrolling shooter: waves, power-ups and a boss every fifth wave. Russian version: [Самолётики](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/samolyotiki/).
- [Battle Tanks](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/battle-tanks/): Defend the base, blast through brick and stop the tanks rolling in from the top. Russian version: [Танчики](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/tanchiki/).
- [Jungle Strike](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/jungle-strike/): Run right, shoot in eight directions and reach the boss on a one-hit life. Russian version: [Десант](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/desant/).
- [Blue Dash](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/blue-dash/): Speed platformer: momentum on slopes, spin roll and rings instead of health. Russian version: [Ёжик](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/yozhik/).
- [Motorbike Rush](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/motorbike-3d/): Pseudo-3D bike racing: sunset, traffic and a timer that never lasts. Russian version: [Реальные мотоциклы](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/moto-3d/).
- [Coast Runner](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/coast-runner/): Pseudo-3D coastal car racing: four lanes, palm trees and heavy traffic. Russian version: [Реальные тачки](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/tachki-3d/).
- [Split Duel](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/split-duel/): Split screen, one track, three laps. You can see your rival ahead — and cut him off. Russian version: [Дуэль на двоих](https://aleksandr-litvinenko.github.io/GamesIO/ru/duel-na-dvoih/).
